paite: Huan Gaza ah Samson ahoh a, huai ah numei kizuak khat ava mu a, ava kithuahpih hi.
heading: Gaza Ah Samson
english: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.

paite: "Samson hiai ah ahong hoh," chi in Gaza mite ahilh uhi. Huchi in ava umta ua, khopi kulh kongpi chin ah zankhua in atang uhi. Zankhua in adai sipsip ua, "Khua hong vak peuhmahleh, huchi in that na ni," akichi uhi.
english: The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, “Wait until morning light; then we will kill him.”

paite: Samson bel zankim tan in alum a, zankim in athou a, khopi kulh kongkhakte leh akhuam nih alen a, akalhnate toh aphawikhe vek a, aliangzang ah apua a, Hebron ma a mualvum ah apotou hi.
english: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, anung in Sorek Phaizang a numei khat a-it a, amin Delailah ahi.
heading: Samson Leh Delailah
english: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

paite: Philistia' miliante akiang ah ahohtou ua, akiang ah, "Amah ka zohtheihna ding un, ahatna san theih tum in kankhia in. Huchi in ka vek un dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat ka hon pe chiat ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.”

paite: Huchi in Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Na hat mahmahna san hon hilh dih ve. Bangchi in ahia hihnat dia khau khihtheih na hih ding?" achi hi.
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”

paite: Samson in akiang ah, "Khauhual thak, keu nai lou sagih in hon hen le uchin, ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding,” achi hi.
english: Samson said to her, “If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”

paite: Huchi in Philistiate' miliante'n khauhual thak sagih, keu nai lou apia ua, ama'n huaite in ahenta hi.
english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

paite: Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite akoih a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e," achi hi. Mei in ziza khaulom akattat bang phet in ama'n khauhual ahihtanta hi. Huchi in ahatna san atheikhe zou kei hi.
english: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room. She said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire. So his strength was not known.

paite: Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Ngai in, na hon khem a, zuau hon hilh na hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? Hon hilhta in," achi hi.
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Khauzen thak, zat nai louh in hon hen le uh, huchi in ka hat kei mai ding, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then I will become weak, and be as another man.”

paite: Delailah in khauzen thak ala a, ahen a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n ahon sual dek uh," achi hi. Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite a-om uhi. Akhut a henna patzang suktat bang mai in ahihtanta hi.
english: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.

paite: Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "N'on khem lai a, zuau na hon hilh lai hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? hon hilh dih ve," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka samphek sagih puan in gatkhum leteh ahi mai," achi hi.
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.” He said to her, “If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom.”

paite: Ama'n kilhna in akilhkip giugeu a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Huchi in ihmu lai ahong halh a, puanbu kilhdenna leh puanbu nangawn toh kikhongsak in apaikhia hi.
english: She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric.

paite: Akiang ah, "Na lungtang hon pe hetloupi in, bangchidan a ka hon it, chi thei na hia oi? Tu'n thumvei hilhial na hon khemta hi, na hat mahmahna san na hon hilh nai kei lailai," achi hi.
english: She said to him, “How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, niteng a ngen ngutngut a, adotdot ziak in, si ding khop hial in alunggimta hi.
english: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death.

paite: Huchi in alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta hi. Akiang ah, "Ka lu ah mulmet tem himhim zat ahi ngei nai kei hi. Ka nu sul a ka om lai a pan Pathian a dia Nazarit mi dia na om ka hi. Tu in met taleng, ka hatna amang vek ding, huchi in ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel ka hi ding," achi hi.
english: He told her all his heart and said to her, “No razor has ever come on my head; for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, then my strength will go from me and I will become weak, and be like any other man.”

paite: Alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta chih Delailah in atheih phet in, "Tu kia hong hoh un, alungsim tengteng ahon hilh vekta," chi in Philistia' miliante thukhak in asamsak hi. Huchi in akiang ah Philistia' miliante ava hohtou ua, dangka atawi uhi.
english: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, “Come up this once, for he has told me all his heart.” Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.

paite: Apheipi tung ah a-ihmusak hi. Mi asam a, asamphek sagihte ametkhesak vek hi. Huchi in amah ahihgim panta a, ahatna in anuseta hi.
english: She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

paite: "Samson, Philistiate'n ahong sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Ihmu lai ahong halh a, "Nidang mah bang in ka pawtkhe nawn ding a, ka kitungkhe nawn ding," achi hi. Himahleh TOUPA'N apaisan khinta chih himhim athei kei hi.
english: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free.” But he didn’t know that Yahweh had departed from him.

paite: Philistiate'n aman ua, amitte akhelkhiaksak uhi. Gaza ah apaipihsuk ua, sikkol abunsak ua; suangkul ah buh gawizantu in apang hi.
english: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.

paite: Himahleh asam met ahih nung in hong pou in ahong khang nawn hi.
english: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.

paite: Philistia' miliante Dagon pathian kiang a kithoihna thupitak lan ding leh kihih nuamsa ding in akikhawm uhi. "I pathian un i melmapa uh Samson ahon peta," achi uhi.
heading: Samson Sihna
english: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice; for they said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.”

paite: Mipite'n amuh un apathian uh aphat ua, "I pathian un i melmapa, i gam hihsia a mi tampite thatpa i khut uah ahon peta," achi uhi.
english: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said, “Our god has delivered our enemy and the destroyer of our country, who has slain many of us, into our hand.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, alungtang un nuam asak laitak in, Samson pen muhnop ding in va sam dih ua, achi uhi. Huchi in suangkul a pan Samson ava samkhia uhi. Ama uah muhnop ding in a-omta a; khuam leh khuam kikal ah adingsak uhi.
english: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the prison; and he performed before them. They set him between the pillars;

paite: Samson in amah kaitu naupang kiang ah, "Hiai inn dou pen khuam hon khoihsak dih ve, ka hon ngai deh," achi hi.
english: and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand, “Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean on them.”

paite: Huai inn, pasal leh numei in adim miuhmeuh uhi. Philistiate milian tengteng huai ah a-om vek ua, Samson muhnop dia en mite intung ah pasal leh numei sangthum a-om uhi.
english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed.

paite: Samson in TOUPA asam a, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, hehpih in hon theigige inla, hehpih in tutung in hon hihhat in, aw Pathian, ka mit langnih phu Philistiate tung ah tu kia hon lasak in," achi hi.
english: Samson called to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”

paite: Samson in, huai inn dou pen sut nihte alen a, akhut taklam in khat, akhut veilam in khat mah apansan hi.
english: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.

paite: Samson in, "Philistiate toh sikhawm ning e," achi hi. Huchi in theihtawp in akunsuk a; miliante leh mipi asung a om tengtengte huai inn chim in adelhkhumta hi. Huchi in adam lai a athahte sang in asihkhumte atamzaw uhi.
english: Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines!” He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords, and on all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life.

paite: Huchi in a-unaute leh apa inkote tengteng ahong paisuk ua, ala ua azawngtou ua, Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal a; apa Manoah kivuina mun ah avuita uhi. Huchi in ama'n kum sawmnih sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.
